name: Integrated MBA
title: Integrated MBA (5-Year IPM)
intro: From Class 12 to a five-year integrated management programme: IPMAT/JIPMAT/NPAT, three-year UG and two-year MBA phases and placements.

phases.title: Class 12 eligibility
phases.summary: Any stream, with minimum marks (usually 60%) in Class 12.
points: Integrated programmes admit students after Class 12 from any stream.
Top institutes like IIM Indore and IIM Rohtak require good Class 10 and 12 marks.
Maths, verbal ability and logical reasoning matter a lot for the entrance.
Start preparing in Class 11 if you aim for the top institutes.

phases.title: Entrance exams and calendar
phases.summary: IPMAT, JIPMAT, NPAT, SET and others.
points: IPMAT Indore and IPMAT Rohtak are separate exams conducted by the respective IIMs.
JIPMAT is held by NTA for IIM Bodh Gaya and IIM Jammu.
NMIMS NPAT, Symbiosis SET and other institutes run their own tests.
Applications generally open in the first half of the year; tests are held from April to June.

phases.title: Selection: interview and counselling
phases.summary: Shortlisting is followed by personal interviews.
points: Institutes shortlist students on the basis of the test score and academics.
Interviews test communication, awareness and clarity about the programme.
Final merit combines test score, interview and Class 10 and 12 marks.
Accept your offer and pay the deposit by the deadline.

phases.title: Phase 1: three-year foundation
points: Years 1–3 cover quantitative methods, economics, accounting, marketing, communication and humanities.
You complete group projects, case discussions and summer internships.
Many institutes allow an exit with a BBA or similar degree after three years.
Maintain grades, since progress to the MBA phase depends on performance.

phases.title: Phase 2: MBA and placements
phases.summary: Advanced management coursework, electives and placements.
points: Years 4–5 resemble a conventional MBA: specialisation electives, internships and strategic courses.
Summer internships lead to pre-placement offers.
You graduate with an MBA or equivalent, subject to the institute’s rules.
Placements are run through the institute’s placement cell.
